nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Index and orientation guide for the Waggle OS deep research series (7 reports from April 2026), summarizing cross-cutting strategic themes about memory as a moat, local-first architecture, GEPA evolution as credibility, and the three-layer OSS/product/enterprise stack.

nodes.name: 01-oss-memory-packaging-strategy.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive strategy for open-sourcing the hive-mind memory system, covering what to OSS vs. keep proprietary, license selection (Apache 2.0), brand/naming, launch tactics, governance model, and a 12-week action plan for the OSS release.

nodes.name: 02-memory-system-scientific-draft.md
nodes.summary: Scientific paper draft for the hive-mind memory system covering architecture (frame model, HybridSearch, KnowledgeGraph, compliance-by-default, wiki compiler), evaluation plan, related work, and appendices with SQL schema and TypeScript API sketches.

nodes.name: 03-memory-harvesting-strategy.md
nodes.summary: Strategic and UX plan for memory harvesting as a lock-in mechanism, detailing six UX principles, three user journey archetypes, a privacy trust chart, phased action plan (A-F), and metrics to prioritize the roadmap.

nodes.name: 03-paper-skeleton-v2-2026-04-30.md
nodes.summary: Ratified arXiv paper skeleton (v2, 2026-04-30) with 7 founder-approved decision points, detailed 10-section paper structure including GEPA Evolution and Scoping Discussion sections, claim traceability matrix, and authoring sequence.

nodes.name: 04-competitive-landscape.md
nodes.summary: Analysis of 11 competitors in the 2025-2026 AI memory market (mem0, Letta/MemGPT, Zep/Graphiti, Cognee, Supermemory, LlamaIndex, LangMem, ChatGPT Memory, Claude Memory, Basic Memory, Hermes), with positioning matrices and a SWOT for hive-mind.

nodes.name: 04-gepa-public-reveal-strategy.md
nodes.summary: Public reveal strategy for the GEPA closed-loop prompt evolution proof, covering claim space (what v1 proved vs v2 will prove), audience-specific messaging for researchers/buyers/engineers, research note structure, Twitter/LinkedIn/HN content plans, and objection handling.

nodes.name: 05-user-personas-ai-os.md
nodes.summary: Voice-of-customer research defining 7 user personas for the Waggle OS AI workspace (Strategic Operator, Knowledge Worker, Developer, Research Scientist, Startup Founder, Enterprise IT Admin, Consumer Prosumer), with cross-persona observations and a persona-to-roadmap heat map.

nodes.name: 06-waggle-os-product-overview.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive product overview of Waggle OS as of April 2026, detailing the verified architecture, 9-component memory stack, GEPA evolution stack, feature taxonomy by tier (Free/Pro/Teams/Enterprise), user patterns, competitive positioning, shipping state, and 2026-2027 success metrics.

nodes.name: 07-skills-connectors-strategy.md
nodes.summary: Shipping strategy for Skills and Connectors as upgrade triggers and self-evolution mechanisms, covering 20 starter skills, 12 hero connectors, tier gates, self-evolution loop, marketplace positioning, and a 5-phase action plan through Q3+.

nodes.name: PAPER-1-CONCEPT_hive-mind-memory.md
nodes.summary: Concept skeleton for the first academic paper on Hive-Mind frame-graph memory, outlining the 12-section structure (Frame Model, Multi-Mind Isolation, Hybrid Retrieval, Wiki Compilation, Compliance-by-Default, Harvest Pipeline), key defensible claims, and prerequisites before full write-up.

nodes.name: PAPER-2-CONCEPT_gepa-evolution.md
nodes.summary: Concept skeleton for the second academic paper on closed-loop GEPA prompt evolution, outlining the 11-section structure (Evolution Pipeline, GEPA Iterative Evolution, EvolveSchema, Constraint Gates, Experimental Design), v1 completed results, v2 experimental design, and key defensible claims.

nodes.name: waggle-hive-mind-paper.md
nodes.summary: Full-length academic paper draft on Hive-Mind covering frame-graph memory with compliance-by-default and closed-loop prompt evolution, including detailed sections on the Frame Model, Multi-Mind Isolation, Hybrid Retrieval, Wiki Compilation, Compliance, Harvest Pipeline, GEPA evolution, experimental results (v1/v2), related work, and appendices with authoritative SQL schema and TypeScript API.
nodes.languageNotes: This 1144-line document is the most comprehensive research artifact in the batch, serving as the full paper draft that the concept skeletons (PAPER-1-CONCEPT, PAPER-2-CONCEPT) and scientific draft (02-memory-system-scientific-draft) are stages toward.
